name: k118lvr
description: Build an Android app named K118. It is an online chat application with: Google Sign-In, user profile with profile photo, friend list, one-to-one real-time chat, chat messages with timestamps, online/offline user status, modern clean UI. Use Firebase Authentication and Firebase Firestore for real-time messages. Create the Android app using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Make the project runnable and organize all required screens, navigation, models, and Firebase integration clearly
